chunks.text: . I also need a new insp

patchOf:
root = Stack([title, kpis, loadsHeader, loadsTable, chartCard, tabs, notice])
title = TextContent("Pottery Studio Firing Log", "large-heavy")
kpis = OverviewCardBlock([k1, k2, k3, k4])
k1 = OverviewCardItem("loads", k1top, k1m)
k1top = IconText(Icon("flame", "tools"), "neutral", "m", "Loads This Month")
k1m = MetricIndicatorInline("8", "Total firings", { direction: "up", value: 14 })
k2 = OverviewCardItem("pass", k2top, k2m)
k2top = IconText(Icon("circle-check", "status"), "success", "m", "Pass Rate")
k2m = MetricIndicatorInline("92%", "Pieces passing inspection", { direction: "up", value: 3 })
k3 = OverviewCardItem("pieces", k3top, k3m)
k3top = IconText(Icon("package", "shopping"), "neutral", "m", "Pieces Fired")
k3m = MetricIndicatorInline("214", "Across all loads", { direction: "up", value: 9 })
k4 = OverviewCardItem("cracks", k4top, k4m)
k4top = IconText(Icon("triangle-alert", "status"), "warning", "m", "Defects")
k4m = MetricIndicatorInline("17", "Cracks, pinholes, glaze flaws", { direction: "down", value: 6 })
loadsHeader = InlineHeader("Kiln Loads", "Recent firings with clay, target and inspection result")
loadsTable = Table([Col("Load", ids), Col("Date", dates), Col("Kiln", kilns), Col("Clay Type", clays), Col("Target", targets), Col("Pieces", pieces, "number"), Col("Result", results)])
ids = ["L-101", "L-102", "L-103", "L-104", "L-105", "L-106"]
dates = ["2024-05-03", "2024-05-07", "2024-05-12", "2024-05-16", "2024-05-21", "2024-05-25"]
kilns = ["Electric A", "Electric A", "Gas B", "Electric A", "Gas B", "Electric A"]
clays = ["Earthenware", "Stoneware", "Porcelain", "Stoneware", "Raku body", "Porcelain"]
targets = ["Cone 04 (1945°F)", "Cone 6 (2232°F)", "Cone 10 (2345°F)", "Cone 6 (2232°F)", "Cone 06 (1828°F)", "Cone 6 (2232°F)"]
pieces = [38, 42, 24, 45, 18, 47]
results = ["Pass", "Pass", "Minor defects", "Pass", "Pass", "Minor defects"]
chartCard = Card([CardHeader("Pieces per Load", "Passed vs. defective"), chart])
chart = BarChart(ids, [Series("Passed", [36, 40, 20, 43, 17, 43]), Series("Defective", [2, 2, 4, 2, 1, 4])], "stacked")
tabs = Tabs([t1, t2])
t1 = TabItem("stages", "Firing Stages (L-106)", [stagesSteps])
stagesSteps = Steps([StepsItem("Candling", "Ramp 100°F/hr to 250°F, hold 2 hrs to drive off moisture."), StepsItem("Bisque / Early Ramp", "Ramp 250°F/hr to 1100°F, burning off organics."), StepsItem("Glaze Ramp", "Ramp 150°F/hr to 2232°F (cone 6)."), StepsItem("Soak", "Hold at peak 15 minutes for glaze maturity."), StepsItem("Cooling", "Natural cool-down for 18 hrs; unload below 150°F.")])
t2 = TabItem("inspect", "Inspection Notes", [inspTable])
inspTable = Table([Col("Load", ["L-103", "L-106", "L-102"]), Col("Issue", ["Pinholing on glaze", "Crazing on 2 mugs", "Small base crack"]), Col("Action", ["Slow cooling next time", "Adjust glaze fit", "Thicken base"])])
notice = Callout("warning", "Kiln Maintenance", "Gas kiln B thermocouple is due for replacement after the next firing.")
request: Mark the first kiln load complete and add an inspection note describing one cracked bowl.
